usedFor: DitCal holds your bookings, and Documint fills a document through “Add Content To Template” for each one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking is added to a Documint template, so booking paperwork starts without retyping.

watchOut: “Meeting Rescheduled” and “Booking Cancelled” are separate triggers, so one template per event keeps the wording right.
